A1.justification: Both complete, readable PDFs describe the same position paper and retain the same five main sections. All 12 pages of each were inspected; neither version contains appendices, figures, tables, or formal equations.

before.justification: V1 synthesizes previous research. Its empirical examples, including French morphological loss and GPT-4 cipher accuracy, are explicitly attributed to earlier publications, including the author's previous work.

after.justification: V3 remains a position paper without original empirical results. Its additional evidence about cross-model homogeneity and diversity collapse is attributed to cited studies.

M1.justification: Neither version introduces an implemented algorithm or model. V3's discussion of post-training and possible future architectures does not introduce a proposed method.

E1.justification: Neither paper conducts training or evaluation on datasets or tasks. Newly discussed open-ended generation studies expand the literature reviewed, not the paper's experimental coverage.

E2.justification: Neither version evaluates a proposed method against baselines. The Transformer, BLOOMZ-7b, LLaMA2-13b, and mT5-large comparison remains attributed to Yin et al. in Section 4.

E3.justification: No original evaluation protocol is specified in either version. Adding COMET to Section 4's discussion of translation metrics does not constitute using a new evaluation metric.

E4.justification: Neither version conducts ablations, robustness tests, or supplementary empirical analyses. V3 adds literature-based discussion and qualifications rather than new analyses performed by this work.

E5.justification: Neither version reports repeated runs, seeds, confidence intervals, error bars, or statistical estimation procedures for results produced by this paper.

E6.justification: The reported external findings change modestly. Section 3.3.2 removes McCoy et al.'s explicit 51% versus 13% cipher-accuracy figures while retaining their qualitative probability effect, and adds homogeneity and diversity-collapse findings from Jiang et al. and Yun et al. These are changes to cited evidence, not original measurements or same-setting performance improvements.

T1.justification: Neither version presents formal assumptions, mathematical definitions, theorems, or proofs. V3's clarification of distributional model collapse is conceptual prose.

C1.justification: The central warning about losing linguistic diversity and the call to preserve it remain. V3 qualifies the abstract's assertion that linguistic tails are vanishing and explicitly scopes the introduction's argument to current mainstream LLMs under prevailing data and training regimes.

C2.justification: V3 adds substantive limitations concerning uncertain long-term language effects, possible mitigation by future architectures, selection bias in the reviewed literature, and interpretations favoring efficiency or standardization. Section 3.3 explicitly limits the discussion to distributional collapse. Section 4 also explains why sentence-level translation metrics should not be expected to measure diversity across systems and time. Together these materially qualify the argument's scope and interpretation.

D1.justification: Neither version provides implementation instructions, experimental hyperparameters, computing resources, or reproducibility artifacts. V3's new acknowledgment of AI-assisted language editing concerns manuscript preparation.

R1.justification: V3 makes focused literature updates covering cross-model homogeneity, post-training diversity, competing meanings of model collapse, and machine-translated web content, citing Jiang, Kirk, Yun, Schaeffer, and Thompson among others. It removes several language-endangerment references, including Hale, Krauss, and Simons and Lewis. The central positioning linking earlier MT findings to LLM diversity loss remains.

P1.justification: V3 extensively rewrites and condenses the prose, especially Sections 2 and 3, and revises the abstract and introduction. It shortens the title, updates the affiliation and acknowledgments, corrects language, and adds a Limitations subsection while preserving the five main sections' order.

P2.justification: Both retain a two-column, text-only layout. V3 separates the position-paper designation from the shortened title and adds selective bold emphasis to discussion and conclusion passages. Neither version has figures or tables to add, remove, or redesign.

improvement.justification: V3 improves clarity and qualification: the new Limitations subsection acknowledges uncertain long-term effects, literature-selection bias, alternative interpretations, and possible architectural mitigation. Updated supporting literature and the clarified metric discussion strengthen the position paper, although condensation removes some quantitative specificity. The central argument remains substantially intact, yielding a limited overall improvement.
